results.question: 购买次数最多的前十个用户是谁（数据时间范围 2017-11-25 至 2017-12-03，请只查这个区间）
results.sql: SELECT user_id AS 用户ID, COUNT(*) AS 购买次数 FROM user_behavior WHERE behavior_type = 'buy' AND date_only BETWEEN '2017-11-25' AND '2017-12-03' GROUP BY user_id ORDER BY 购买次数 DESC LIMIT 10

results.question: 各行为类型的数量分布（数据时间范围 2017-11-25 至 2017-12-03，请只查这个区间）
results.sql:
SELECT behavior_type AS 行为类型, COUNT(*) AS 数量 FROM user_behavior WHERE date_only BETWEEN '2017-11-25' AND '2017-12-03' GROUP BY behavior_type ORDER BY 数量 DESC
LIMIT 1000

results.question: 每天的活跃用户数趋势（数据时间范围 2017-11-25 至 2017-12-03，请只查这个区间）
results.sql: SELECT date_only AS 日期, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS 活跃用户数 FROM user_behavior WHERE date_only BETWEEN '2017-11-25' AND '2017-12-03' GROUP BY date_only ORDER BY 日期 LIMIT 100

results.question: 浏览到购买的转化率是多少（数据时间范围 2017-11-25 至 2017-12-03，请只查这个区间）
results.sql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN behavior_type = 'buy' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN behavior_type = 'pv' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100, 2) AS 浏览到购买转化率 FROM user_behavior WHERE date_only BETWEEN '2017-11-25' AND '2017-12-03'
LIMIT 1000

results.question: 哪些商品被加购但从来没被购买过（数据时间范围 2017-11-25 至 2017-12-03，请只查这个区间）
results.sql: SELECT item_id AS 商品ID, COUNT(*) AS 加购次数 FROM user_behavior WHERE behavior_type = 'cart' AND date_only BETWEEN '2017-11-25' AND '2017-12-03' AND item_id NOT IN (SELECT item_id FROM user_behavior WHERE behavior_type = 'buy' AND date_only BETWEEN '2017-11-25' AND '2017-12-03') GROUP BY item_id ORDER BY 加购次数 DESC LIMIT 100

results.question: 购买行为主要发生在一天中的哪些时段（数据时间范围 2017-11-25 至 2017-12-03，请只查这个区间）
results.sql: SELECT HOUR(date) AS 小时, COUNT(*) AS 购买次数 FROM user_behavior WHERE behavior_type = 'buy' AND date_only BETWEEN '2017-11-25' AND '2017-12-03' GROUP BY HOUR(date) ORDER BY 购买次数 DESC LIMIT 24

results.question: 被浏览最多的前十个商品（数据时间范围 2017-11-25 至 2017-12-03，请只查这个区间）
results.sql: SELECT item_id AS 商品ID, COUNT(*) AS 浏览次数 FROM user_behavior WHERE behavior_type = 'pv' AND date_only BETWEEN '2017-11-25' AND '2017-12-03' GROUP BY item_id ORDER BY 浏览次数 DESC LIMIT 10

results.question: 收藏最多但一次都没买的商品有哪些（数据时间范围 2017-11-25 至 2017-12-03，请只查这个区间）
results.sql: SELECT item_id AS 商品ID, COUNT(*) AS 收藏次数 FROM user_behavior WHERE behavior_type = 'fav' AND date_only BETWEEN '2017-11-25' AND '2017-12-03' AND item_id NOT IN (SELECT item_id FROM user_behavior WHERE behavior_type = 'buy' AND date_only BETWEEN '2017-11-25' AND '2017-12-03') GROUP BY item_id ORDER BY 收藏次数 DESC LIMIT 20

results.question: 加购转化率最高的十类商品类目（数据时间范围 2017-11-25 至 2017-12-03，请只查这个区间）
results.sql: SELECT category_id AS 商品类目, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN behavior_type = 'buy' THEN user_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN behavior_type = 'cart' THEN user_id END) AS 加购转化率 FROM user_behavior WHERE date_only BETWEEN '2017-11-25' AND '2017-12-03' AND behavior_type IN ('cart', 'buy') GROUP BY category_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN behavior_type = 'cart' THEN user_id END) > 0 ORDER BY 加购转化率 DESC LIMIT 10

results.question: 购买次数最多的用户集中在哪几天（数据时间范围 2017-11-25 至 2017-12-03，请只查这个区间）
results.sql: SELECT date_only AS 日期, COUNT(*) AS 购买次数 FROM user_behavior WHERE behavior_type = 'buy' AND date_only BETWEEN '2017-11-25' AND '2017-12-03' GROUP BY date_only ORDER BY 购买次数 DESC LIMIT 10

results.question: 行为总数是多少（数据时间范围 2017-11-25 至 2017-12-03，请只查这个区间）
results.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS 行为总数 FROM user_behavior WHERE date_only BETWEEN '2017-11-25' AND '2017-12-03'
LIMIT 1000

results.question: 有多少个不同的用户产生过行为（数据时间范围 2017-11-25 至 2017-12-03，请只查这个区间）
results.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS 活跃用户数 FROM user_behavior WHERE date_only BETWEEN '2017-11-25' AND '2017-12-03'
LIMIT 1000

results.question: 购买次数超过 50 次的高价值用户有多少个（数据时间范围 2017-11-25 至 2017-12-03，请只查这个区间）
results.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS 高价值用户数 FROM (SELECT user_id FROM user_behavior WHERE behavior_type = 'buy' AND date_only BETWEEN '2017-11-25' AND '2017-12-03' GROUP BY user_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 50) t
LIMIT 1000

results.question: 用户的购买频次分布：买 1 次的、2-5 次的、5 次以上的各有几人（数据时间范围 2017-11-25 至 2017-12-03，请只查这个区间）
results.sql:
SELECT CASE WHEN 购买次数 = 1 THEN '1次' WHEN 购买次数 BETWEEN 2 AND 5 THEN '2-5次' ELSE '5次以上' END AS 购买频次区间, COUNT(*) AS 用户数 FROM (SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS 购买次数 FROM user_behavior WHERE behavior_type = 'buy' AND date_only BETWEEN '2017-11-25' AND '2017-12-03' GROUP BY user_id) t GROUP BY 购买频次区间 ORDER BY 用户数 DESC
LIMIT 1000

results.question: 加购了但没购买的用户有多少人（数据时间范围 2017-11-25 至 2017-12-03，请只查这个区间）
results.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS 加购未购买用户数 FROM user_behavior WHERE behavior_type = 'cart' AND date_only BETWEEN '2017-11-25' AND '2017-12-03' AND user_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM user_behavior WHERE behavior_type = 'buy' AND date_only BETWEEN '2017-11-25' AND '2017-12-03')
LIMIT 1000

results.question: 每个商品从浏览到购买要经过几次行为（数据时间范围 2017-11-25 至 2017-12-03，请只查这个区间）
results.sql: SELECT item_id AS 商品ID, COUNT(*) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT user_id), 0) AS 人均行为次数, COUNT(*) AS 总行为次数, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS 用户数 FROM user_behavior WHERE date_only BETWEEN '2017-11-25' AND '2017-12-03' GROUP BY item_id ORDER BY 总行为次数 DESC LIMIT 100

results.question: 最近一天的活跃用户数是多少（数据时间范围 2017-11-25 至 2017-12-03，请只查这个区间）
results.sql: SELECT date_only AS 日期, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS 活跃用户数 FROM user_behavior WHERE date_only BETWEEN '2017-11-25' AND '2017-12-03' GROUP BY date_only ORDER BY 日期 DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: 行为量最大的前五个类目（数据时间范围 2017-11-25 至 2017-12-03，请只查这个区间）
results.sql: SELECT category_id AS 类目ID, COUNT(*) AS 行为量 FROM user_behavior WHERE date_only BETWEEN '2017-11-25' AND '2017-12-03' GROUP BY category_id ORDER BY 行为量 DESC LIMIT 5

results.question: 既收藏又加购了的商品有几个（数据时间范围 2017-11-25 至 2017-12-03，请只查这个区间）
results.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS 商品数 FROM (SELECT item_id FROM user_behavior WHERE date_only BETWEEN '2017-11-25' AND '2017-12-03' AND behavior_type IN ('fav', 'cart') GROUP BY item_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT behavior_type) = 2) t
LIMIT 1000

results.question: 浏览量和购买量相差最大的前十个商品（数据时间范围 2017-11-25 至 2017-12-03，请只查这个区间）
results.sql: SELECT item_id AS 商品ID, SUM(behavior_type = 'pv') AS 浏览量, SUM(behavior_type = 'buy') AS 购买量, SUM(behavior_type = 'pv') - SUM(behavior_type = 'buy') AS 差值 FROM user_behavior WHERE date_only BETWEEN '2017-11-25' AND '2017-12-03' GROUP BY item_id ORDER BY 差值 DESC LIMIT 10

results.question: 只浏览过一次就再也没来过的用户有多少（数据时间范围 2017-11-25 至 2017-12-03，请只查这个区间）
results.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS 只浏览过一次的用户数 FROM (SELECT user_id FROM user_behavior WHERE behavior_type = 'pv' AND date_only BETWEEN '2017-11-25' AND '2017-12-03' GROUP BY user_id HAVING COUNT(*) = 1) t
LIMIT 1000

results.question: 商品被收藏后最终购买的比例大概是多少（数据时间范围 2017-11-25 至 2017-12-03，请只查这个区间）
results.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN behavior_type = 'buy' THEN item_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN behavior_type = 'fav' THEN item_id END) AS 收藏后购买比例 FROM user_behavior WHERE date_only BETWEEN '2017-11-25' AND '2017-12-03'
LIMIT 1000
